common: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity desktop UI design screenshot for Plasmic, a visual web application editor. Landscape 16:10, ideally 1920x1200 or larger. Flat straight-on screenshot, no monitor frame, no perspective, no presentation decorations or captions outside app. Consistent professional design system: canvas background #17181C, floating panels #25262C, controls #303139, borders #3C3D46, text #ECECF1, muted text #ADA EBC (use #ADA EBC without spaces conceptually #ADA EBC grey), accent soft violet #AEA0FF with muted violet active backgrounds. Clean modern sans serif, sharp clear Simplified Chinese UI text and English component identifiers. Compact professional tool density, generous canvas space, refined 10px panel radius, subtle shadows, opaque panels, no neon glows or excessive gradients. Inspired by pen.dev floating edge-docked controls and Figma organized properties, branded only Plasmic. Chinese product labels; business sample is 客群管理, page 客群列表. Important: dark editor chrome must surround a WHITE business page with its own subtle blue accents; never make the business page dark. Use coherent visual structure and realistic complete UI, minimal readable text, crisp recognizable icons.
